title: Signed announcements channel
body:
MNSTRY now publishes announcements as signed JSON documents committed
under `announcements/` in this repository. This is a pull-only channel:
you receive announcements by running `git pull`, and pulling is the
consent act. There is no push channel, no subscription, and no tracking —
the kit never fetches announcements or anything else over a network.

Every announcement is signed with the MNSTRY announcements key. The
public half is committed at
`announcements/keys/mnstry-announcements.public.v1.json`; verify any
announcement with:

    atelier announcements verify announcements/<file>.json

or list and verify everything at once with
`atelier announcements list`. A document that does not verify should be
treated as not from MNSTRY. See docs/announcements.md for the full
convention.
